config: C (pinned F1 flags; README run command)
notes: Config C (README run command) reads only the files listed under 'files', the dataset and, on CUDA machines, the downloads. Checked by tracing file opens (2026-11-21).

The query/ caches pinned in some run_config.json files (artifacts/experiments/text_based_rag/query/...) are provenance only: config C runs with --fresh-captions and never reads them. The older non-fresh pipelines (load_existing_captions, query_embedding.py, query_retrieval.py) cannot be re-run from these assets.

The f2llm-v2-0.6b encoder (codefuse-ai/F2LLM-v2-0.6B) is loaded without a pinned revision, so the revision used by the saved runs is unknown; it matters only for live query embeddings, not for runs that reuse the cached embeddings listed here.
Weights and llama.cpp are needed on CUDA machines only; scripts/fetch_assets.sh downloads and checks them.

downloads.optional: only for the Q4 vs BF16 comparison

gpu.driver: 580.178.04 (RTX 5090), as recorded by the saved runs

mac.packages: numpy, requests, pillow (no PyTorch): retrieval-only and checks
